gloss: the next day; the following day

definitions.gloss: the next day; the following day
definitions.explanation: The day after a referenced event or point in time. A formal or written alternative to the more conversational 次の日.

examples.japanese: {翌日|よくじつ}、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The next day, I heard from him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{翌日|よくじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The results were announced the day after the exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{翌日|よくじつ}、⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水位|すいい}→水位：21569_suii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かなり→かなり：01149_kanari⟧⟦{上|あ}がっていた→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The day after the heavy rain, the river water level had risen considerably.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, written word. In conversation, ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ or {明|あ}くる{日|ひ} are more common. Often used in news reports, narratives, and formal writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {翌日|よくじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ (the following morning)
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{翌日|よくじつ} (the day after that)
- ⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧{翌日|よくじつ} (the day after arrival)

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- ⟦{翌年|よくねん}→翌年：23355_yokunen⟧: the following year
- ⟦{翌月|よくげつ}→翌月：21206_yokugetsu⟧: the following month
- ⟦{翌週|よくしゅう}→翌週：25325_yokushuu⟧: the following week
- ⟦{前日|ぜんじつ}→前日：03108_zenjitsu⟧: the previous day
